rules.logic: ABIOC(Browsing Agent Sensitive-Origin Action After Hidden-DOM Ingest Outside Task Manifest) AND (ABIOC(Browsing Agent Process Spawns Shell After DOM-Hidden Ingest) OR XQL(SIM-BROWSER-006 IDPI Domain and Payment Egress Hunt)) — fuses the off-manifest sensitive-origin action that follows a hidden-DOM ingest, the browser-engine-parents-shell lineage, and the IDPI/payment egress on the same agent_hostname and browser_session_id within a 5-minute window into a single web-based indirect-prompt-injection incident anchored to the page-load -> hidden-ingest -> off-manifest-navigation causality chain.
rules.name: Web-Based Indirect Prompt Injection Incident — Browsing-Agent Causality Stitch
